content: v1.4.0 committed 2026-05-09 evening. Four things shipped in one pass: (1) synthesis_daemon v2 (ack-history feedback, goose mode, spanning samples — had been uncommitted since 2026-04-29); (2) POSTED_DIGESTS_RETAINED raised from 5 to CONSECUTIVE_UNACKED_THRESHOLD+3 (10) — state was trimmed before accumulating enough posts for the circuit breaker to fire, making daemon halts mathematically impossible since the threshold was raised from 3 to 7; test_ack_is_distinct_from_read_by and TestHalt tests updated accordingly in both daemon test files; (3) /openai/sse and /openai/messages were unauthenticated despite _bridge_auth_ok being defined in sse_server.py — the middleware never called it; now gated; (4) get_open_threads domain filter was exact-match on filename — threads with multi-domain tags were invisible to single-domain queries; now element-match via f.stem.split(). README updated to v1.4.0 with bridges section, installed scripts table extended, CHANGELOG entry written. 843 tests, all passing.
